newsitem.title: DENMARK: Clinton backs return of Glenn as astronaut.
newsitem.headline: Clinton backs return of Glenn as astronaut.

text.p: U.S. President Bill Clinton on Friday said he would like to see Senator John Glenn, the first American to orbit the Earth, make a return trip to space as the world's oldest astronaut.

The 75-year-old Glenn, who plans to retire from the Senate, has talked with Clinton about the possibility of taking another mission into space, the U.S. president told reporters onboard Air Force One enroute to Denmark from Romania.
"I'm for it ... I think it would be a great thing," Clinton said, noting it would provide a chance to measure the impact of weightlessness on the elderly.
"I told him I'd like to go," Clinton said.
